column1: # ZAP rule configuration for scripts/zap-scan.sh (all three scans).
# Format (tab-separated): rule id, IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL, (rule name), reason.
# Rules not listed stay at WARN. Add an IGNORE only after triage, with the reason.
# Note: any rule line here makes zap-api-scan.py run every installed active rule
# (its "Default Policy") instead of the smaller built-in API-Minimal set.
# Deliberately NOT ignored: 10055 (CSP). Its two findings (style-src unsafe-inline,
# img-src https:) are accepted, but the same rule would report a weakened
# Next.js answers a redirect() from a server component with 307 plus the app
# shell (~6.6 KB of RSC payload, no user data); every such redirect trips 10044.
